snippet.title: Hollow Floor - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAY THE DEMO AND WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3847090/Hollow_Floor/
https://noseticgames.itch.io/hollow-floor

Hollow Floor is a psychological horror walking simulator set in a looping, scorched apartment. Stalked by a restless corpse, you must unravel the truth before you're consumed by it.
